_comment: Accepted Semgrep findings (contrib/semgrep/README.md, 'Accepting a finding'). findings: fingerprint -> {rule, path, reason, by, date}. rule_paths: [{rule (glob), paths (globs), reason, by, date}]. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

504101100dd3bad7.reason: -nodes writes the TLS key unencrypted on purpose: the server reads it at start-up without a passphrase prompt (cmd/root.go --tls-key). The script chmods it 600 and is documented as a local/test helper; production certificates come from a real CA (README 'TLS').

d4c46cb083f10fe6.reason: GetBlockRange (upstream zcash/lightwalletd, unchanged): wallets legitimately sync the whole chain in one range. Each height is served from the local block cache (common.GetBlock refuses heights outside [firstBlock, nextBlock)), never from the node, and the stream is back-pressured by resp.Send; the cost is bounded by the chain length and paid at the client's read rate.

8225be455a5c78db.reason: testclient is the upstream stress/test client run against a local plaintext server (--no-tls-very-insecure); it is not built into the image or shipped (Dockerfile builds only lightwalletd and lwdinfo).

rule_paths.reason: Zcash ZIP-143/ZIP-243/Sapling test vectors (ephemeral keys, commitments: public transaction fields) and documentation examples, not secrets (checked 2026-10-23). A secret anywhere else is still reported; gitleaks scans every commit as well.
Tests decode the node's committed contract fixtures (testdata/) into generic maps to compare them field by field; no untrusted input, nothing ships.
The devnet suite (-tags devnet, run only by scripts/devnet-test.sh) runs the node's own ycash-cli with arguments the test composes; no external input.
